t: Combination set of both drill and screwdriver bits. Includes bits suitable for drilling in metal, wood, plastic and masonry along with all the most common screwdriver sizes.
b: Contents: 13 Brad Point Wood Bits, 12 Metal Drill Bits, 3 Masonry Drill Bits, 2 Holesaw Bits, Mandrel Bit, 7 Nut Drivers, Countersink, Magnetic Bit Holder, 60 Screwdriver Bits & Storage Case.
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary & Impact Modes
Suitable for Masonry, Plastic, Metal & Wood
